purpose: Character style concept for the new painted WFC cave. User then requested simpler 2D designs suited to T-pose and Spine cutout animation. Visual review only.
nativeDimensions: Record actual tool output after generation; requested size is not a guarantee.

referenceImages.role: Cave palette, linework, environment and small character scale reference
Original character identity reference: round cyan hood, simple warm face

artContract.output: Original painted concept plus two simpler 2D front T-pose / side setup design sheets. Not separated animation parts.
artContract.shapePrecision: Original concept has three views. Follow-up designs use front T-pose and side setup with visible limb divisions. No collision, exact turnaround registration or rigging claims.
artContract.style: Follow-up A: simple teal hooded explorer. Follow-up B: human miner with soft cap, ochre shirt and teal trousers. Limited shading, simple contours and no dangling accessories.
artContract.rationale: Large source illustration for style exploration; built-in image generation is suitable. No low-resolution tiles are being produced.
artContract.constraints: No jetpack, no built-in headlamp, no new gameplay claims. Preserve original artist files. Actual Spine parts would require joint overlap completion and dedicated side-view drawing; do not treat the composite design sheet as a ready-to-import rig.
